goal: Compare three local-first sync libraries for our notes app and recommend one.

steps.instructions: Collect facts on the three libraries (license, maintenance, size, conflict handling). Save sources and quotes in notes files; every claim needs a source.
Write report.md with the comparison table and a recommendation, using only the sourced claims from the research notes.
Check every claim in report.md against its source. Fix or remove claims that do not hold, and list what changed in the handoff note.
